title: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Ubisoft Montreal build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag. Steam store metadata did not return a structured release date for this SKU; release dating is flagged for manual confirmation against the 2013 original release record.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Ubisoft Connect services where the client requires them.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency and launcher requirements. Always-online checks and Ubisoft service policy remain principal risks. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam store API returned no structured release date for app 242050 at curation. Steam store copy identifies the title as the classic 2013 pirate action-adventure. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody, distinct from Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced (LIB-0071).
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

steam.shortDescription: Discover Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag, the classic pirate action-adventure game from 2013. Command your ship, hunt Templars and carve your legend as Edward Kenway across the Caribbean's Golden Age of Piracy.

synopsis: Ubisoft Montreal’s Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag on Steam — retained as a permanent digital holding in the Assassin's Creed series, filed alongside the later Resynced remaster.
